text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold positions after substantial gains, which felt rewarding; next time I should weigh each stock’s outlook and my allocation plan rather than treat a gain as a reason by itself to sell.","After selling winners, I mostly left the rest of the portfolio untouched. I should review all holdings periodically and make deliberate decisions, not let reluctance to trade replace reassessment.","The recent decline is modest compared with earlier gains, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and judge my choices against a clear, long-term plan."]}
